title: The ice machine, 2022
logline: The motel's ice machine at 4 AM, its blue, the breezeway, a bucket left on top. The page the strip drew in 2012; the private one drops the hallway and keeps the blue.

panels.composition: A motel ice machine glowing blue in a breezeway at night, a plastic bucket left on top of it, the vending machine beside it dark.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel ice machine glowing blue in a breezeway at night with a plastic bucket left on top and a dark vending machine beside it, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
